title: Aaron Rodgers, in vintage form, takes shots at Saints on the field and the NFL off it

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers, in vintage form, takes shots at Saints on the field and the NFL off it
sources.description: In contrast — of course — to the usual narrative that the NFL has too many international games, Rodgers endorsed the overseas slate, and wished the NFL would have gone further to push American football into international markets.
